item.title: TTT 413: Car Crazy
item.description:
It’s an episode from the road! If you like road noise and Eurovision coverage this episode will be your new favourite. No need to thank us.

Music

  • Ladyhawke - Sunday Drive (Gigamesh Remix)
  • The Auteurs - Car Crazy

Eurovision

  • Albania - Elhaida Dani - I’m alive
  • Armenia - Genealogy - Face The Shadow
  • Austria - The Makemakes - I Am Yours
  • Belgium - Loïc Nottet - Rhythm Inside
  • Czech Republic - Marta Jandová and Václav Noid Bárta - Hope Never Dies
